title: Immunome Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 1 Trial Evaluating IM-3050, an FAP-Targeted Radioligand Therapy, in Patients with FAP-Expressing Advanced Solid Tumors
summary: BOTHELL, Wash., July 20, 2026--Immunome, Inc. (Nasdaq: IMNM), a biotechnology company committed to developing first-in-class and best-in-class targeted cancer therapies, today announced that the first patient has been dosed in the Phase 1, first-in-human trial of IM-3050, an investigational FAP-targeted radioligand therapy being evaluated in patients with FAP-expressing advanced solid tumors.
